answer: Locks are recorded in wharf, expire in terrace, and ridge lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 21 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 171 aliases hence needs 183 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4899 identities would post 2984 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
